podcast.title: Core Member of The Jarpers
podcast.body: Jim MacArcy was considered part of the "hard core classic" of The Jarpers, alongside K3C. This duo provided a consistent foundation for the band amidst its frequent changes in guitarists. "Teníamos como un núcleo duro clásico que era el que formaba en K3C y Jim MacArcy."

srcs.episode: The Yardbirds, una banda clave para entender la historia de la música

podcast.title: Founding Renaissance
podcast.body: Following the breakup of The Jarpers, Jim MacArcy, with K3C, co-founded the band Renaissance. Unfortunately, this new group did not achieve widespread success. "K3C MacArcy acababan fondando el grupo Renaissance que bueno los pobres no tuvieron mucho éxito con él."
